description: This Java class manages local subscriptions for a pub/sub system, handling topic data, subscription filters, and updates within the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.pubsub.ddata.literal'. It includes implementation for creating subscription instances, exporting updates, and equality/hashCode overrides.

classes.name: LiteralSubscriptions
classes.description: Final class managing hash code sequence subscriptions, extending AbstractSubscriptions and providing specific behaviors for topic management and updates.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new LiteralSubscriptions instance with empty subscription maps and initial updates.

methods.name: hashTopic
methods.description: Overrides superclass method to return the topic as-is, representing the subscription topic as a string.

methods.name: onNewTopic
methods.description: Hook method called when a new topic is added; in this implementation, it performs no action.

methods.name: onRemovedTopic
methods.description: Hook method called when a topic is removed; in this implementation, it performs no action.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports the current updates, either forcefully replacing all or resetting after export.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on updates and superclass equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on updates and superclass hash code.
